tools.what: compile the crate. --offline, the registry cache arrives through CARGO_HOME
run the test suite, which is what both checks below are built on
the lint gate: -D warnings is what w-clippy has to satisfy
rustfmt, so a diff is not half formatting

sandbox.notes: A human runs `cargo test --locked --offline` from the crate root, then `cargo clippy --locked --offline --all-targets -- -D warnings`. A cell is a bare worktree with no `target/`, so its first build is a cold one; `target/` is this crate's own output and every cell writes it, so it is not linked. `vendor/` is, because `cargo vendor` output is read-only and identical for every cell. `cargo fetch` is the only step that wants the network and no check runs it: the registry cache reaches the cell through CARGO_HOME and the pinned toolchain through RUSTUP_HOME, both of which the cell would otherwise lose.

work.what: Make `tariff::quote` return `Err(QuoteError::ZeroDistance)` for a trip of zero miles instead of dividing by the mileage and panicking. Cover it with a test beside the existing tariff tests.
Clear the clippy warnings the zero-mile branch adds, without changing the signature of `tariff::quote`.
